_note: The SET_OFF lines of SETOFF-ACROSS-HEADS, SETOFF-HOUSE-PROPERTY: the loss taken against the other heads; a house-property loss is set off under SETOFF-HOUSE-PROPERTY, any other under SETOFF-ACROSS-HEADS. Only SET_OFF lines: each row also writes a MEASURE line for the amount allowed or left, so adding every line counted the set-off twice (found by W-093a's loss persona, D-658; corrects D-655). Drafted by Claude, adopted by the owner's rulings (W-092).
